sloka: अथवा तौ नरव्याघ्रौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।मन्निमित्तमनार्येण समरे ऽद्य निपातितौ।अहो धिङ्मन्निमित्तो ऽयं विनाशो राजपुत्रयोः ।। ६.९३.५२ ।।
transliteration: athavā tau naravyāghrau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau।mannimittamanāryeṇa samare 'dya nipātitau।aho dhiṅmannimitto 'yaṁ vināśo rājaputrayoḥ ।। 6.93.52 ।।

translations.english: 'Or else, have the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana fallen to unworthy Ravana on my account'?
